requests.question: Confirm service sponsorship, required grading and algorithm/module/product scope.
Supply permitted implementation/version, module/firmware, SDK/interface and applicability of existing grading.
Confirm content-key custody, retention, escrow and recovery requirements.
Provide submission proforma, design material, authoritative vectors, methods and acceptance criteria.
Confirm key generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, destruction and repair procedures.
Confirm suite migration, historical access, downgrade protection and change re-evaluation.
Confirm permitted classification and public-Internet exchange conditions.
Name authorised users, enrolment/issuer/PKI, OS/devices and authentication requirements.
Nominate lab, representative hardware/network, witnessing, formats and fees/waiver applicability.
Confirm hosting, remote administration, logging, separation and operational model.
Specify hardware custody, attestation, device-loss recovery and zeroisation.
Agree NDA/IP/handling restrictions and approved source/document transfer channels.
